title: ever MINTA|Elegant Strappy Bow Back Satin Mermaid Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning statement in this satin mermaid dress that hugs your curves beautifully. The elegant V-neck design complements the flattering fit, while the unique knot detail at the front adds a chic touch. The strappy back with a bow brings a playful yet sophisticated flair, perfect for bridesmaids seeking a blend of comfort and style. Suitable for weddings and formal events, this dress ensures you stand out while feeling glamorous.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back


Undergarments: It is Padded Enough For No Bra Option, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
